test_click_admin_and_access_lpr.title: Verify navigation to Admin page and LPR menu visibility

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The Admin menu shows an LPR entry.

steps.action: Click LPR.
steps.expected: The Lists page opens and shows the Create List button.

test_lpr_page_ui_elements.title: Verify LPR page UI elements are present

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The Lists page opens.

steps.action: Check the page controls.
steps.expected: The Create List button, the List and Categories tabs, the lists table, and the Search field are all visible.

test_create_lpr_list.title: Create a new LPR list with valid data

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The Lists page opens.

steps.action: Click Create List.
steps.expected: The Create List dialog opens with a List Name field and a type dropdown.

steps.action: Enter a unique name in the List Name field.
steps.expected: The field shows the name.

steps.action: Open the type dropdown and choose White List.
steps.expected: The dropdown closes and shows White List.

steps.action: Click Save.
steps.expected: The dialog closes.

steps.action: Find the new list in the table.
steps.expected: A row with the new name is listed.

test_search_lpr_list_by_name.title: Search for LPR list by name

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The Lists page shows at least one list row.

steps.action: Type the name of the first list into the Search field.
steps.expected: The table shows a row with that name.

test_open_list_and_verify_plate_page.title: Open a list and verify plate page UI

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The Lists page shows at least one list row.

steps.action: Click the View icon on the first list row.
steps.expected: The Plate page opens with the Add Plate button and a plate table.

test_list_actions_visible.title: Verify View, Edit, and Delete actions are available for lists

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The Lists page shows at least one list row.

steps.action: Look at the action icons on the first list row.
steps.expected: The row shows View, Edit, and Delete icons.

test_list_status_toggle.title: Verify list status toggle is present and interactive

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The Lists page shows at least one list row.

steps.action: Look at the first list row.
steps.expected: The row shows a status toggle.

test_apply_filter_shows_search_results.title: Verify applying a filter shows Search Results view

steps.action: Click Admin, then LPR, and click the View icon on the first list row.
steps.expected: The Plate page for that list opens and shows the Add Plate button.

steps.action: Click the Filter icon.
steps.expected: The filter panel opens with the Apply button.

steps.action: Click Apply.
steps.expected: The Search Results view opens with its header.

test_reset_filter_returns_to_plate.title: Verify resetting filter returns to Plate page

steps.action: Click Admin, then LPR, and click the View icon on the first list row.
steps.expected: The Plate page for that list opens and shows the Add Plate button.

steps.action: Click the Filter icon, then click Apply.
steps.expected: The Search Results view opens.

steps.action: Click Reset.
steps.expected: The Plate page opens again with the Add Plate button.

test_filter_panel_toggle.title: Verify filter panel can be opened and closed

steps.action: Click Admin, then LPR, and click the View icon on the first list row.
steps.expected: The Plate page for that list opens and shows the Add Plate button.

steps.action: Click the Filter icon.
steps.expected: The filter panel opens with the Apply and Reset buttons.

steps.action: Click the Filter icon again.
steps.expected: The filter panel closes and the Apply button is hidden.
